overall.verdict: A coherent, unusually honest wallet: the green/violet 'yours vs promised' system, the one-scale bars, and the sovereignty/receipt/dispute screens communicate enforceability better than anything in this category. It loses points where protocol vocabulary (capacity, routes, basis points, entity ids) leaks into first-run flows and where critical safety actions (Cover it, credit-limit buffer) are under- or over-weighted relative to their risk.
priority_fixes: Translate protocol jargon at the point of action: 'capacity'→'receiving room', 'route'→'via', 'collateral/credit' consequences inline on every slider and receive screen
Default the 'Add 10% credit buffer' checkbox to OFF and render credit-limit changes as bold before→after diffs with the risk sentence on the control itself
Promote 'Cover it' (uncovered debt) to a real button and reconcile the double movement counts on Activity
Split swap into Simple (best-price quote, total cost incl. cross-network hops) and Advanced (limit, book, lot rounding); always show net receive
Simplify Move/Receive for first-timers: hide entity-id inputs behind 'someone else', single-path radios become text, human-readable payment handle next to the QR
